description: 6th connection of this batch. 5th connection read TOBi's own docs (prepare-the-project/rules.mk.md) and found the real cause of every prior 'Nothing to be done for all': Rules.mk is not optional/edge-case-only (as this batch's own comment-only Rules.mk claimed) - it's the primary mechanism that tells TOBi what objects to build at all, via 'OBJNAME.TYPE: sourcefile' rule lines (confirmed against the docs' own worked example and the bundled sample_project1's real, working Rules.mk: 'HELLO.MODULE: HELLOP.RPGLE'). Fixed templates/part08-project/Rules.mk to declare real targets (ZAISRV.MODULE: zaisrv.rpgle / ZAISRV.SRVPGM: ZAISRV.MODULE zaisrv.bnd) instead of being 100% comments. This connection retries the build with the corrected Rules.mk, still targeting the empty &LIB2 (<USER>B) library so a failure can't damage anything Part 7 established. Also greps TOBi's own mk/def_rules.mk for the SRVPGM pattern rule as a read-only diagnostic in case the SRVPGM dependency line's exact form needs adjusting.

steps.label: SETUP
steps.cmd:
rm -rf "$HOME/mk8"
mkdir -p "$HOME/mk8/z"
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/zaisrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/ZAISRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/zaisrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/IPROJJSN.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/RULESMK.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/mk8/z/Rules.mk') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 -c "p='$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json'; d=open(p,'rb').read(); open(p,'wb').write(d.replace(b'YOURUSER2', b'&LIB2'))"
echo ---IPROJ-JSON---
cat "$HOME/mk8/z/iproj.json" </dev/null
echo ---RULES-MK---
cat "$HOME/mk8/z/Rules.mk" </dev/null
echo ---TREE---
find "$HOME/mk8/z" -type f </dev/null
echo ---DEF-RULES-SRVPGM---
grep -n -B2 -A15 '^%\.SRVPGM\|SRVPGM:' /QOpenSys/pkgs/lib/tobi/src/mk/def_rules.mk </dev/null 2>&1 | head -60

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAISRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE
SELECT PROGRAM_LIBRARY, PROGRAM_NAME, PROGRAM_TYPE, PROGRAM_OWNER FROM QSYS2.PROGRAM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB2' AND PROGRAM_NAME = 'ZAISRV'
